SubRIP bundles the helper and its resource bundle, not the CodexBar GUI. No system install or global configuration changes. Existing service sessions are read by upstream collectors. All stdout is parsed to an allowlist of quota, plan label, source and hashed account scope; raw identities and errors are discarded.
